# Jamil Isaac Ramirez Muñoz

**B.Sc. in Mechanical Fluids Engineering**

Hydrology • Hydraulics • Water Resources

I am a Peruvian researcher and practitioner working in hydrology, hydraulics and environmental data science. My interests include hydrological modelling, precipitation analysis, uncertainty assessment, extreme events and data-driven approaches for water resources applications.

This website provides access to my publications, research projects, technical notes and reproducible workflows developed using open datasets, R and Quarto.

## Current Research

### Bayesian Hydrology

Development of Bayesian approaches for hydrological prediction using rolling observational windows, hydroclimatic predictors and temporal information to evaluate how changing data availability influences predictive uncertainty and model performance.

## Recent Highlights

- Published research on bias correction and frequency analysis of satellite precipitation in the Piura River Basin.
- Published comparative research on traditional and machine learning methods for daily streamflow infilling in representative Peruvian basins.
- Published research on bias-corrected precipitation products and parameter transferability in a data-scarce Andean basin.
- Ongoing research on rainfall–runoff modelling and hydrological uncertainty in the Cañete River Basin.
- Ongoing research on Bayesian hydrological prediction using rolling observational windows and hydroclimatic information.
